label: EUII
description: End User Identifiable Information. Information identifying an end user, such as an email address, User Principal Name (UPN), IP address, address book entry, user name, or display name. Aligned with [Privacy in Microsoft Purview](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/purview/purview-privacy#end-user-identifiable-information-euii). Other categories can also contain personal data.

label: EUPI
description: End User Pseudonymized Identifiers. Identifiers representing an end user, such as UserID, UserKey, or mailbox GUID, as described in [Privacy in Microsoft Purview](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/purview/purview-privacy#end-user-pseudonymized-identifier-eupi). They may be linked to a person using additional information. Pseudonymized does not mean anonymous.

label: Customer Content
description: Content a customer provides or generates, such as documents, messages, files, or AI interactions. This existing modeling category is narrower than Customer Data, which also covers configuration and other service data. Assess the actual content for personal or sensitive information; the category alone does not set retention, access rules, or a universal sensitivity rank.

label: OII
description: Organization Identifiable Information. Information identifying a tenant or organization, such as a tenant ID or organization name. An additional modeling category, not a named Purview content type. Related contacts, sole-trader records, or combined information can also identify individuals.

label: System Metadata
description: Operational metadata generated by a service, such as request IDs, timestamps, diagnostic events, or correlation identifiers. An additional modeling category, not a named Purview content type. Logs and metadata may contain EUII, EUPI, or other personal data; assess their content and linkability.

label: Feedback Data
description: Feedback submitted by a user or administrator about a product or service, such as ratings or free-form comments. Aligned with the [Feedback data](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/purview/purview-privacy#feedback-data) category in Microsoft Purview; this application is not limited to Purview's feedback platform. Feedback may contain personal or sensitive information.

label: Access Control Data
description: Authorization records such as permissions, roles, group memberships, or access control lists. An additional modeling category, distinct from Administrator Data about people performing administrative duties. Records can reveal security-sensitive structure and identify individuals.

label: Support Data
description: Data exchanged or collected during a support engagement, such as case notes, diagnostic dumps, or customer-provided artifacts. This modeling category can contain customer content and personal or sensitive data. See [Microsoft Support and Professional Services guidance](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/compliance/regulatory/gdpr-dsr-prof-services); Support Data is not a synonym for all Professional Services Data.

label: Account Data
description: Subscription, billing, and account-configuration information associated with an organization or user account. An additional modeling category, not a named Purview content type or a synonym for Administrator Data. Account details can identify individuals.

label: Administrator Data
description: Information about an administrator processed in connection with administrative duties, such as their email address, UPN, IP address, user name, or display name when configuring policies or connectors, assigning labels or tasks, or placing data on legal hold. Aligned with [Administrator data in Microsoft Purview](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/purview/purview-privacy#administrator-data). Distinct from the permission records in Access Control Data; it may also be identifiable personal data.

label: Customer Data
description: A broad customer-data modeling category aligned with [Microsoft Purview](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/purview/purview-privacy#customer-data): customer content, custom configuration, search queries and results, alerts, reports, connector-ingested data, and classification labels. Broader than Customer Content; existing content items are not automatically reclassified. This label does not determine contractual scope, personal-data status, or service-specific retention obligations.

label: Other
description: An application category for data not adequately described by another entry. Describe the actual data and seek classification guidance. Other does not mean non-personal, low-risk, or exempt from privacy requirements.
